title: Samanoud Textiles minimum-wage strike reported ongoing in September
exclusion_reason: Out-of-month lead, not an October 2024 event on available evidence. CTUWS states on September 28 that the strike was on day 11; a September 4 CFJ release also covers the strike. A separate Mada Masr result dated October 21 returned 403 and cannot establish continuation. Do not infer that the strike ended or continued beyond the sources.

start_date.summary: Both accessible reports are dated in September 2024; CTUWS states the strike was in its 11th day on September 28.

title: Journalists’ Syndicate-area protest against dismissal under Law 73, June 2024
exclusion_reason: Out of Q4 scope. ECESR dates this protest to June 1, 2024; it is not an October event.

start_date.summary: ECESR says the employees were detained Saturday June 1 and released Sunday June 2, 2024.
